related.title: Willow 閾值模型：碼距增加何時有效
related.titleEn: Willow threshold models: when greater distance helps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每個格點都要有角色與相鄰檢查，額外備援明列；量子位元總數不等同可用邏輯數。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assign every site a role and adjacent checks, listing reserves separately; total qubits do not equal usable logical qubits. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 以明示的近似縮放式檢查「增加量子位元」的前提。
related.differenceEn: Use an explicit approximate scaling law to test the premise behind adding qubits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。碼距d=5，僅估一個靜態邏輯記憶區，不含路由與閘區。 N=2d²−1。 代入 2*5**2-1，得到 49 qubits。本課理想旋轉平面碼用d²資料及d²−1校驗，共2d²−1；額外耦合、備援與邊界設計需另計。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。A=0.1、p=0.001、p閾=0.01、d=5，皆為合成擬合參數。 pL=0.1×(0.001/0.01)^3。 代入 0.1*(0.001/0.01)**3，得到 0.0001 logical errors/cycle。教學模型pL=A(p/p閾)^((d+1)/2)；係數與閾值依雜訊、碼、解碼器而變，並非通用常數。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Distance d=5 for one static logical memory patch, excluding routing and gate regions. N=2d²−1. Substituting 2*5**2-1 gives 49 qubits. This ideal rotated planar code usesd² data andd²−1 checks, totaling2d²−1; couplers, reserves and boundary choices are separate. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Synthetic fit parametersA=0.1,p=0.001,pthreshold=0.01,d=5. pL=0.1×(0.001/0.01)^3. Substituting 0.1*(0.001/0.01)**3 gives 0.0001 logical errors/cycle. Teaching modelpL=A(p/pthreshold)^((d+1)/2); constants depend on noise, code and decoder. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assign every site a role and adjacent checks, listing reserves separately; total qubits do not equal usable logical qubits. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用四項搜尋完整追蹤振幅，證明更多迭代不一定更好。
